delta.partial_json: It is nil in production, so

units.headline: Add test hook invoked before eviction in head-view compaction
units.summary: Package-level hook that tests use to inject appends. It is nil in production, so it has no runtime effect there.
units.reason: The hook only fires when a test sets it.

units.headline: New function type for building restricted head views
units.summary: An unexported type alias for the view constructor. The behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked.
units.reason: Unexported type declaration with no logic.

units.headline: New evictor function type with watermark contract docs
units.summary: An unexported function type plus a doc comment on the append-ID watermark contract. It contains no logic.
units.reason: Type declaration and docs only; the logic is in other units.

units.headline: Shared head-view compaction loop with append-ID eviction watermark
units.summary: Pulls the per-chunk-range write/reload loop out of CompactStaleHead into a shared helper. It captures an append-ID watermark before writing blocks so eviction can skip series that got late samples, and it skips reload when Write returns no ULIDs.

issues.title: Test callback global is read and cleared without synchronization
issues.failure_scenario: Parallel tests that set the hook would race on the global. Production is unaffected.

units.reason: Changes compaction and eviction safety, which can lose data.
focus: Check that the watermark from iso.lastAppendID() is taken before any block writer's isolation snapshot
Check that skipping reload when len(uids)==0 cannot hide a failure
With isolation disabled, late appends are still evicted and lost

units.headline: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked with watermark
units.summary: Stale compaction now goes through the shared helper. Its eviction predicate now also requires no OOO data and no post-watermark appends.
units.reason: Changes which stale series get evicted.
focus: Stale series that are skipped because of late appends must have their numStaleSeries accounting stay correct

units.headline: Comment rename gcStaleSeries to gcSeries in test
units.summary: Only a test comment changed.
units.reason: Comment-only edit in a test file.

units.headline: Test that a late append during compaction survives restart
units.summary: New test that injects an append through the hook and checks visibility before and after restart. Expectations differ by isolation mode.
units.reason: New test only.
